home.tagline: Alchemists of the Great Year — rules wiki for players at the table.
home.card.search.title: Search
home.card.search.body: Press **Ctrl+K** (or **⌘K** on Mac) to find any rule, term, or phase instantly.
home.card.tabs.title: Four tabs
home.card.tabs.body: **Learn** for lore and overview, **Play** for setup and rounds, **Reference** for the compendium, **Glossary** for quick definitions.
home.card.share.title: Share a rule
home.card.share.body: Click a page heading to copy a direct link — send it to your table when a dispute comes up.
home.card.offline.title: Install offline
home.card.offline.body: Use your browser’s **Install app** option (or Add to Home Screen on mobile). Works at the table without Wi‑Fi after the first visit.
home.card.modes.title: Game mode modifiers
home.card.modes.body: Toggle **Quickplay** and **Magnus** modifiers in the header to show or hide ⚙️ rule variants.
home.card.newPlayers.title: New players
home.card.newPlayers.body: Start [Guided Play](/play/guided/) to walk through components and setup step by step. Keep [Round at a Glance](/play/round-at-a-glance/) open during the game.
guided.mode.title: Choose your game mode
guided.mode.intro: This sets which rules and deck build apply at your table. You can change modifiers anytime in the header.
guided.mode.quickplayDesc: Shorter economy and beginner Crucible deck — best for first playthroughs.
guided.mode.standardDesc: Full rules as written in the guide, with the balanced Crucible deck.
guided.mode.magnusDesc: Standard rules plus alignment effects on trades, duels, gambits, and oppositions.
guided.resume.title: Resume guided play?
guided.resume.body: You have saved progress from a previous visit.
home.footer: *A GOODMAGIK Game. Rules content is synced from `Kismeta_GameGuide.md` — run `npm run sync` after editing the guide.*
glossary.intro: A reference to every capitalized game term used throughout the guide. Return here any time you need a quick definition mid-game.
